definition.name: specht_epr_state
definition.definition: The Specht module EPR state |EPR_lambda> for a partition lambda |- n is the maximally entangled state in Sp_lambda tensor Sp_lambda: |EPR_lambda> = (1/sqrt(dim(lambda))) sum_S |S> tensor |S>, where the sum ranges over all standard Young tableaux S of shape lambda. This state plays the role of the maximally entangled state in the permutation (Specht) register of the double Schur basis. It appears in the decomposition of the symmetric subspace projector Pi_sym^{n,D} in the double Schur basis (Lemma 3.1).
